entries.title: Chat, a transport switch and Christmas mode
items: Chat: servers, channels, DMs and group DMs with replies, reactions, polls, threads, files, and voice and video calls. Open it from the island; it needs an account.
Chat stays live over one connection, catches up on anything you missed after a reconnect, and keeps only recent history in memory, so leaving it open doesn't keep using more.
Moderation: server owners get reports, AutoMod, timeouts, bans and an audit log; breeze staff can warn and mute accounts chat-wide and review, delete or purge messages.
Transport: pick Epoxy or libcurl under Settings, Proxy. It applies after a reload.
Christmas mode: light falling snow and a Santa hat on the breeze title and logo. It's on by default; turn it off under Settings, Appearance.
A page that fails to load in the browser now shows a readable error in your theme instead of a blank frame.
The chat icon in the island is now the same size as the others.

entries.title: Browser engine update
items: The browser now runs on Scramjet 2.1.0, the first stable release of the 2.x engine, for steadier page loads and sign-ins.

entries.title: Music, accounts and cloud saves, Roblox and bookmarks
items: Music: search and play songs, albums and artists, keep liked songs and playlists, import playlists from Spotify, and open the now playing view for lyrics and the queue.
A music player in the island, the browser toolbar and the game player while something is queued; turn it off in Settings, General.
Accounts: sign up in Settings, Account with a username and password, and set a display name, bio, picture and banner.
Cloud saves: save your games, browser and settings to your account and restore them on any computer.
Roblox: the island's Roblox button opens roblox.com with a guide to signing in, and games open in Breeze's Roblox player.
Browser bookmarks: star a page in the address bar to keep it in a grid above your tabs.
Hold my Tabs: a Proxy setting that keeps your browser tabs open and loaded when you close the browser.
A new Google Sans Rounded font, and slightly lighter Lexend text.

entries.title: More sources and caption timing
items: Seven new movie sources: Ember, Vortex, Zephyr, Onyx, Echo, Haven and Comet, plus every Flux mirror on its own.
If a source fails or stalls, the player moves on to the next one by itself, and looks for more once they've all failed.
Caption timing: nudge subtitles earlier or later from the captions menu when they're out of sync.
Custom font: pick Custom under Settings > Appearance > Font and type any Google Fonts name to use it everywhere.

entries.title: Orbit removed
items: Orbit is gone from the source list: its streams stopped loading, so picking it only led to an error.

entries.title: New sources and player controls
items: Two new movie sources: Orbit and Prism join the lineup, so more titles have a working stream.
Source switcher: sources now have codenames and expanding them shows the available qualities.
Caption controls: a master on/off switch at the top, with the language list nested underneath.

entries.title: Server switcher
items: Pick a Breeze server yourself in Settings, Proxy, or leave it on Auto to use the first one that's working.

entries.title: Custom backgrounds, glass, custom accents and game downloads
items: Custom backgrounds: upload an image or paste a link in Settings, Appearance, and set how much it is dimmed.
Glass: a new Appearance switch that makes panels, buttons and menus frosted and see-through.
Custom accent: pick any colour from the new Custom option in the accent list.
Download the game you're playing: the new button next to close saves it as an HTML file. It still loads the game's files from Breeze, so you need to be online.

entries.title: Release!
items: Welcome to Breeze! Thanks for stopping by. If you like this website, share it with friends.
